Trump Gives ‘America’s Mayor’ the Presidential Medal of Freedom

President Donald Trump on Tuesday presented Rudy Giuliani, the former Mayor of New York City who served as Trump’s personal lawyer in 2020, with the Presidential Medal of Freedom. Appearing on Steve Bannon’s War Room podcast on Monday, Giuliani said that he was “very, very humbled and very honored” by the recognition.
